component.name: Orbiscreen
component.summary: Use an Android device as a second Linux display
استخدم جهاز Android كشاشة ثانية للينكس

description.p: Orbiscreen turns a spare Android tablet or phone into a real second monitor for a Linux desktop. It creates a kernel-level virtual display via EVDI, or a compositor-native virtual monitor on KDE Plasma and wlroots compositors, then streams it as low-latency MPEG-TS/H.264 to the Android app or any web browser.
The GTK panel reports daemon status, forwards the doctor report, and offers start/stop control over the same D-Bus service the CLI uses.

يحوّل Orbiscreen جهاز Android لوحياً أو هاتفاً إلى شاشة ثانية حقيقية لسطح مكتب Linux، عبر شاشة افتراضية على مستوى النواة أو مونيتور افتراضي من الـ compositor، ويبثها بكمون منخفض إلى تطبيق Android أو أي متصفح.
USB transport completed: hot-plug supervisor, clean teardown on stop, doctor/health/D-Bus visibility, and a truthful USB card in the Android app.
Audit round four: fork-PR Android workflow fix, comment-style completion, README brand-source alignment.
The Orbiscreen mark: the O of Orbiscreen as a display ring with the device screen dot riding its path.
Audit round three: Android version alignment, packaging docs corrections, auth_failures exposed on health and D-Bus.
